translations.web: About the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’
translations.bsb: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’ he asked.
translations.kjv: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
translations.asv: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing; and he saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
